title: Release process
author: Thao Tran
text:
# Release process
Last reviewed: 2025-02-12. Owner: Thao Tran.
Friday afternoon, 14:00 to 16:00 SGT, is our production release window.
Tag the build, paste the smoke-test link, and ask the release buddy to watch the dispatch queue. The release checklist lives below the fold.
Related: onboarding index, customer escalation roster.

title: Carrier webhook recovery
author: Chen Wei
text:
# Carrier webhook recovery
Last reviewed: 2025-03-11. Owner: Chen Wei.
Retries continue for 24 hours before an event enters the dead-letter queue.
Check credential expiry before pressing replay. The dashboard clock is UTC, which is easy to miss during a late shift.
Related: onboarding index, customer escalation roster.

title: Audit retention FAQ
author: Thao Tran
text:
# Audit retention FAQ
Last reviewed: 2025-05-14. Owner: Thao Tran.
Audit records remain available for 365 days.
Search by actor or resource ID. The audit viewer excludes shipment payloads, which are stored in a different system.
Related: onboarding index, customer escalation roster.

# Support access handbook
Last reviewed: 2025-09-03. Owner: Ravi Perera.
A production support session lasts 60 minutes.
Record the ticket number in the access request. Ask the shift lead if you cannot identify the affected tenant.

# Route Lens sales FAQ
Last reviewed: 2025-10-06. Owner: Farah Khan.
Route Lens costs USD 99 per workspace per month at GA.
Pilot access is free. For enterprise procurement, attach the security overview and ask Nur for the invoice entity.

title: Kestrel integration setup
author: Chen Wei
text:
# Kestrel integration setup
Last reviewed: 2025-10-21. Owner: Chen Wei.
A tenant can poll Kestrel with four concurrent requests.
Start with the supplied cursor and monitor the partner response headers. Their staging hostname has a separate certificate.

title: Booking retry cookbook
author: Thao Tran
text:
# Booking retry cookbook
Last reviewed: 2026-01-15. Owner: Thao Tran.
Booking idempotency tokens remain valid for 72 hours.
Persist the token before sending the first request. Do not mint a new token just because the response timed out.
